books.title: The Little Fish
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A little fish lives in the blue sea. Her name is Bubbles.
Bubbles swims all day. She swims up and down.
Bubbles sees a big rock. She hides behind the rock.
A big fish swims by. Bubbles stays very still.
The big fish goes away. Bubbles swims home to her mum.

books.title: Rose and the Rain
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Rose looks out of the window. It is raining.
Rose puts on her red boots. She takes her umbrella.
Rose jumps in a puddle. Splash! The water goes up.
Rose laughs and jumps again. Splash, splash, splash!
The rain stops. The sun comes out. Rose is happy.

books.title: Tom's New Hat
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Tom has a new hat. It is blue with a red band.
Tom puts on his hat. He looks in the mirror.
Tom goes to the park in his hat. The wind blows.
Oh no! The wind takes Tom's hat. It flies up high.
The hat lands in a tree. Tom climbs up and gets it back.

books.title: The Small Ant
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A small ant walks on the grass. He looks for food.
The ant sees a big crumb. It is too big for him!
The ant calls his friends. "Help me, please!" he says.
All the ants push the crumb. Push, push, push!
They take the crumb home. Now they all have food.
